1.note: Field-signature MATCHES the validated ST1 paid_spin/Normal (StopSymbolsByCol[3 cols]+PayoutByPayline+PayoutIdToWinAmount+CostCredits=1000>0). Native payids on 7048/40000 winning rounds (PayoutIdToWinAmount populated, e.g. {'9':330}, with PayoutByPayline '1:8-8(...)'). The PAID base spin (rtp_integrity.paid_st). 295/40000 base spins carry ReMarks='Trigger Minigame; ' + RewardLastNode=['666-'] and pay 0 credits themselves — that base spin OPENS the ListRewardWheel minigame, which the following ST139 settles.

139.note: Reward-list settlement (FeatureWin key 'ListRewardWheel'). CostCredits=0 (free, granted by the preceding ST1 'Trigger Minigame' base spin), GameplayTriggerType=1, WinCredits>0 on 295/295. The reel-field KEYS are present but ALL EMPTY (StopSymbolsByCol=[], PayoutByPayline=None, PayoutIdToWinAmount={} on 100%) — there is NO payline/reel win and NO native payid: the real win is purely WinCredits (13,218,000 in-sample == server FeatureWin['ListRewardWheel'] EXACT). A BARE no-payid settlement (economy=real) in the M43/M279/M283/M210 wheel/minigame precedent; field-signature MATCHES M210 ST139 settlement/ListRewardWheel verbatim. ReMarks carries the per-round 'Minigame CellIndexes: <6-13 comma-separated cell ids>,curTimes:0,totalTimes:0' (a reward-list/wheel lottery) + RewardLastNode the per-cell prize-code ladder (numeric tiers + codes like 12404). The labeled cell-map / per-cell prize un-merge is parser_blind (per-ST extraction layer, framework-team). No collect-coin channel: no SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols populated on ANY ST, and the win is not additive alongside a payline pid (T2, NOT a live-collect T3). NO native payid -> requires a config-only SynthesizePayIdRule (synthesize_pay_id, label_format=spin_type) to mint pid 'st139' and zero _unattributed_st139 (coordinator writes the json — needs_synth). Count 295 ST139 == 295 ST1 'Trigger Minigame' base spins (1:1, no orphans).

trigger.note: No round-level trigger pid. The reward-list feature fires server-side: a base spin (ST1, ReMarks='Trigger Minigame; ', RewardLastNode=['666-'], win 0) -> the ListRewardWheel settlement (ST139, the only win). The exact trigger probability is rawdata-unobservable; the feature opened 295/40000 paid spins in-sample. Unlike M210 there is NO intermediate Selector (ST111) marker — M124 goes ST1 -> ST139 directly.

validation.evidence: Provenance clean (_cache_version:3 on the chunk, single config bucket de38395b/435291bd, _bet=1000, _dev_sample:true, NOT virtual). 40,295 rounds over 8 robots in chunk_0001. ST roles derived from THIS machine's OWN fields: ST1 paid_spin/Normal (CostCredits=1000>0, full 3-col reel + native payids; signature MATCHES validated ST1); ST139 settlement/ListRewardWheel (CostCredits=0, reel-field keys present-but-empty, real win purely WinCredits, NO native payid; signature MATCHES M210 ST139 verbatim). Per-ST WinCredits == server FeatureWin EXACT (Normal 17,750,840/40000; ListRewardWheel 13,218,000/295). No collect-coin channel (no SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols populated on any ST; win not additive alongside a payline pid) -> T2, NOT a live-collect T3. ST139 no-payid settlement attributed via a config-only SynthesizePayIdRule (m124_listrewardwheel_settlement, synthesize_pay_id, spin_types=[139], label_format=spin_type) — EXACT M43/M279/M283/M210 precedent; coordinator writes the rule (status=needs_synth). base_hash 3ddaa183f38c unchanged (manifest-only T2 onboard, no new plugins, no closure change). validation.status=auto pending user domain sign-off (gate 8).
caveats: ST139 reward-list per-cell prize map (the 'Minigame CellIndexes' 6-13 cell-id list + RewardLastNode per-cell prize-code ladder) is parser_blind: the shared monolith parser keeps only sample ReMarks/ST, not the per-round CellIndex/RewardLastNode accumulation. The settled win's multiplier banding IS base-derivable via the generic spin_type_rtp_buckets / spin_type_outcomes plugins; the labeled cell-map breakout needs the per-ST extraction layer (DIRECTION.md section 3, framework-team) — same boundary as the M279/M210 wheel CellIndex map.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST1/ST139 round but =0 on 100% of the in-sample records. FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): it IS a real progressive jackpot store, but the CURRENT testspin interface forces its accumulation to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1/ST139 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE (excludes the progressive); it grows when the field is enabled. Record once per machine, no per-machine re-confirmation (fleet-wide).
